description: This file contains the implementation of a PHP trait 'MessageTrait' for the GuzzleHttp library, providing shared functionality for HTTP message requests and responses, including header management, protocol versioning, and body handling.

methods.name: getProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns the HTTP protocol version used in the message.

methods.name: withProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns a new message instance with the specified HTTP protocol version.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves all headers as an associative array.

methods.name: hasHeader
methods.description: Checks if a specific header is present.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves all values for a specific header.

methods.name: getHeaderLine
methods.description: Retrieves headers as a comma-separated string.

methods.name: withHeader
methods.description: Returns a new message with the specified header set.

methods.name: withAddedHeader
methods.description: Returns a new message with the specified header added.

methods.name: withoutHeader
methods.description: Returns a new message without the specified header.

methods.name: withBody
methods.description: Returns a new message with the specified body stream.
